about: Worker B's see-through probe (coordinator approved Nov 16; spec: artifact 'Worker B: see-through balls, Remix paths and probe spec', Step 2). One launch at con_bright_hall, the 20261115-142638 switch pose (the spot's y0_p0, Sam still), on the staged build. [Proxy] TexHashLog=1 for the whole launch: the proxy reads it only at start and hashes each texture as the game uploads it, so it cannot be turned on for the capture second alone. Steps on / off ([Lights] FlareStandIns=0) / on_again, each set explicitly and proven by its 'settings reloaded' line; each step takes its switch still and gate depth, the light dump, then the 19 Remix debug views from a screen grab (3 s hold each, debugViewIdx 0 again after). The draw dump and Remix USD capture run at the end of on_again (the same state as on) instead of in on, because the capture turns replacement assets off and on again, which would change the scene before the off step; after on_again nothing else is measured. B scores it.
